records.title: Directed Studies in Orthodontics (*)
records.text: ORTHO 449 Directed Studies in Orthodontics (*) Students and faculty with common academic interests pursue them together within the curriculum by means of independent study and a tutorial student-faculty relationship. Credit/no-credit only. Offered: AWSpS.
